message.content:
I collapsed the four derived-member copies into one constant-size bulk copy over that member span, reducing the constructor to a single move after the base copy.

```cpp
#include <cstring>
```

```cpp
Field::Field(const Field &field)
    : FieldBase(field)
{
    std::memcpy(static_cast<void *>(&profile),
                static_cast<const void *>(&field.profile),
                static_cast<std::size_t>(
                    reinterpret_cast<const char *>(&field.isFieldExpanded + 1) -
                    reinterpret_cast<const char *>(&field.profile)));
}
```
